title: P15.9-A2 production default Company Cockpit cutover with explicit legacy rollback
description: BASE bdeae5aa651cbfb586ed23a1dd09ff448dda0730. P15.9-A2 UI cutover: production builds default legacy routes to /app, root to /app/company; Vite dev stays legacy-first. pair.legacy_redirect='app' forces new UI; 'legacy' is per-browser rollback on any build; absent/unknown key uses build default, never grants authority. Zero src/pair/* or serve-script changes. Executed: tsc clean, vite build clean, Playwright on production dist (serve-mission-control.mjs — NOT Vite dev): b6 8/8, suite 193/217. Baseline contrast run on BASE worktree, same env/store/Chromium: all 10 representative failures reproduce identically on BASE — 22 mint-path tests fail closed FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_NO_ELIGIBLE (template planner removed c7c280f; no eligible codex-cli planner in e2e env; direct API evidence 409), system:107 transitively needs minted routing data, objectives:586 tz bug failed on BASE and is fixed here.
